Business: Sharma General Store – Kirana / general store, Palasia, Indore
Format: Storytelling
Lens: 2, Everyday Moments
Hook: Everyday crisis – Annex C, pulled 2026-10-05
Moment: Sharad Navratri
@@CHARACTER1@@
Ramesh (owner) — 48, male, wheatish brown skin, short grey-black hair, white kurta with a navy sleeveless jacket, steel wristwatch, reading glasses on a cord.
@@CHARACTER2@@
Sunita (customer) — 38, female, medium brown skin, hair in a low bun, mustard cotton saree with a maroon border, thin gold bangles, cloth shopping bag.
@@SETTING@@
A small neighbourhood kirana in Palasia, Indore, early evening. Warm tubelight over a wooden counter, steel weighing scale, gunny sacks of atta and sabudana on the floor, neatly stacked shelves of packets behind, freshly painted walls and a clean tiled floor, marigold garlands and a toran over the entrance with small brass lamps for Navratri, a scooter passing on the lane outside. UIs needed: none.
